bias.en: Recovering · above the 5 and 10-day, testing the 30 and 100-day
bias.zh: 修复中 · 站上 5 日和 10 日均线，测试 30 日和 100 日均线

read.en: Amazon rose 2.1% on Nov 3 to $250.69, trading between $245.89 and $252.44. It is above the falling 5-day ($247.0) and 10-day ($249.8) and the rising 200-day ($243.5), and just below the rising 100-day ($252.0) and falling 30-day ($252.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 23 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 22 ($256.09), and RSI is 49.
read.zh: 亚马逊 11月3日上涨 2.1%，收于 $250.69，盘中区间 $245.89–252.44。股价位于下行的 5 日（$247.0）和 10 日均线（$249.8）以及上行的 200 日均线（$243.5）上方，略低于上行的 100 日（$252.0）和下行的 30 日均线（$252.5）。MACD 自 10月23日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月22日起看空（$256.09），RSI 为 49。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $247.5–249.1 resistance (5-day, Oct 29 high) and the 10-day, now support; the high of $252.44 stalled at the 100 and 30-day. Resistance is $252.0–252.5, then $253.8–256.1 (Nov 2 high, SAR) and $259.5 (Sep 21 high). Support is $247.0–249.8, then $242.3–244.7 (200-day, September and Nov 2 lows) and $229.4. A close above $252.5 would target $254–256; below $247, $243–244.

s.en: 200-day average $243.5; Sep 16 and Sep 28 lows ($244.3–244.7); Nov 2 low $242.3
